titulo_en: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers

textos.Reviews reclamam que o filme é longo dem: Reviews complain that the film is too long and drawn-out, with stretches that seem endless and that made viewers fall asleep or walk out of the screening.
textos.Pessoas descrevem a experiência como ent: People describe the experience as boring, saying that the story does not spark interest and that it is hard to care about what happens on screen.
textos.Críticas apontam que os personagens são: Reviews point out that the characters are superficial or irritating, highlighting the lack of charisma of some and the feeling that they do not evolve over the course of the plot.
textos.Excesso de batalhas e CGI questionável: Excess of battles and questionable CGI
textos.Reviews consideram que o filme tem batal: Reviews consider that the film has long, repetitive battles, and that the visual effects, especially the computer-generated ones, look dated or exaggerated.
textos.Sensação de que o filme é apenas uma pon: Feeling that the film is merely a bridge
textos.Comentários afirmam que a trama não avan: Comments state that the plot does not advance significantly, working more as a transition between the first and third films, without an engaging story of its own.
textos.Críticas mencionam que a única personage: Reviews mention that the only significant female character has a secondary role, which bothered a portion of the audience.
textos.Reviews medianas consideram o filme exce: Middling reviews consider the film excessively long and slow, with stretches that seem to go on unnecessarily, making the experience tiring at certain moments.
textos.Este grupo aponta que a continuação não: This group points out that the sequel does not maintain the same level of interest as the previous film, being seen as inferior in construction and engagement.
textos.As sequências de batalha dividem opiniõe: The battle sequences divide opinion: middling reviews find them visually impressive and exciting, while others find them overrated or excessively long.
textos.O trio formado por Aragorn, Legolas e Gi: The trio of Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli is widely praised, as is the pair of hobbits and the character Gollum, who generates varied reactions, being considered interesting by some and irritating by others.
textos.Reviews medianas descrevem a obra como u: Middling reviews describe the work as a bridge between the first and third films, feeling that the main plot advances little and that the film serves only to prepare the ending.
textos.Os aspectos técnicos, como efeitos práti: The technical aspects, such as practical effects, cinematography and score, are recognized as high quality, but not always enough to inspire lasting emotional involvement.
textos.Batalha do Abismo de Helm e cenas de açã: Battle of Helm's Deep and action scenes
textos.A sequência da batalha no Abismo de Helm: The battle sequence at Helm's Deep is cited as the high point of the film, with emphasis on its epic scale, impressive choreography and tension, and is considered by viewers to be the best action scene of the entire trilogy.
textos.Reviews mencionam que o filme é longo e: Reviews mention that the film is long and that the first half or first two-thirds can be slow, but that this is made up for by an exciting, well-paced final act.
textos.As atuações são elogiadas, especialmente: The performances are praised, especially Andy Serkis as Gollum, Sean Astin as Sam and Viggo Mortensen as Aragorn, as well as the comic relief provided by Gimli and Legolas.
textos.Os efeitos visuais, a fotografia e a tri: The visual effects, cinematography and score are widely praised, with emphasis on the quality of the practical effects and the visual grandeur of the battles, although viewers find the CGI dated at certain moments.
textos.O personagem Gollum é mencionado como um: The character Gollum is mentioned as one of the strengths, with his emotional complexity, Andy Serkis's performance and the inner conflict highlighted as moving and well portrayed.
textos.Reviews comparam este filme ao primeiro: Reviews compare this film to the first in the trilogy, considering it superior in story development, action and emotion, although it is sometimes seen as a bridge or a transitional film.
